notes.subject: sisan
notes.rationale: The interrogative העת implies 'now'; Bambara question frame 'Yala … wa' plus 'sisan' carries the challenge.

notes.subject: minnu sanfɛ bɛ datugu
notes.rationale: ספונים 'roofed/paneled' (passive participle of ספן) rendered descriptively as houses whose roofs are covered.

notes.subject: aw yɛrɛw
notes.rationale: The emphatic pronoun אתם 'you yourselves' sharpens the rebuke; kept as 'aw yɛrɛw'.

notes.subject: so … sow
notes.rationale: Hebrew contrasts בתיכם 'your houses' with הבית הזה 'this house'; the Bambara so/sow contrast keeps the parallel.

translation: Yala waati bɛ aw ye sisan, aw yɛrɛw, ka sigi aw ka sow kɔnɔ minnu sanfɛ bɛ datugu, wa so in na, a bɔnna?
